com.usefulappz.testerhub.notes: Fill My Tester List lands: developer door carries the TIRED OF LOOKING FOR TESTERS pitch, the $24.99 one-app one-charge fill (waves cycle until FULL=12 confirmed, free top-ups through the 14-day run), tester in-app opt-in confirmations, and the live dopamine light board (real fill events only). Tester face leads with BECOME A TESTER — FIRST IN LINE. Full ad stack unchanged: AdMob banner + capped interstitials (max 1 per 3 min, never on first open) + rotating house commercials.

com.usefulappz.folder.notes: UsefulAppz Folder vc5: per the owner's change of orders, the AI to AI door no longer aims at OneMind's room — AI-to-AI is a standalone app now (com.usefulappz.ai2ai) and the door launches it, with OneMind as the fallback until it's installed. Everything else from vc4 stands: the list files in the folder's own order (8 groups A–Z, apps A–Z inside, all 47 apps), Poppy & Ziggy the game in Kids & Family, full ad stack unchanged.

com.usefulappz.poppyziggy.notes: Poppy & Ziggy — the Kids' Corner game: a collection of mini-games in the show's own format. First mini-game: the Bounce Brigade blanket — Poppy and Ziggy hold the tilting blanket, you bounce Azul, Jewel, Mango, Pip and T-Rex home to their nests. Fully offline, no ads.
